title: Exhausting the unit cube by the inner cubes Q_δ in the double-integral oscillation
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, Q₁ := {y ∈ Euclid n : 0 < y_i < 1 for all i} and, for δ ∈ ℝ, Q_δ := {z ∈ Euclid n : δ < z_i < 1 − δ for all i} (Lebesgue measure). Let u : Euclid n → ℝ be integrable on Q₁ and K ∈ ℝ with ∫_{x∈Q_δ}∫_{y∈Q_δ}|u(x) − u(y)| dy dx ≤ K for every δ ∈ (0, 1/2). Then ∫_{x∈Q₁}∫_{y∈Q₁}|u(x) − u(y)| dy dx ≤ K.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (u : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (K : ℝ), IntegrableOn u {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 → ∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, ∫ y in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, |u x - u y| ≤ K) → ∫ x in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, |u x - u y| ≤ K
